invariants.rationale: activeModule is a String parameter likely representing a module name; typically such parameters are expected to be non-null in context setters.
activityDescription is a String parameter describing an activity; typically expected to be non-null for job status reporting.
activeModule, when used to denote a module name, is often expected to be non-empty.
activityDescription is usually expected to be a non-empty description.
activeModule and activityDescription likely denote distinct concepts and should not typically be identical.
